{
  "name": "read-along",
  "version": "0.9.2",
  "description": "Listen to Claude's replies while the sentence being read is highlighted. Local voices (Kokoro, or your system's own), several languages, auto-read, and a player above the prompt.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Yotam Sechayk",
    "url": "https://github.com/tomfluff"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/tomfluff/claude-read-along",
  "repository": "https://github.com/tomfluff/claude-read-along",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "accessibility",
    "text-to-speech",
    "tts",
    "read-aloud",
    "dyslexia",
    "low-vision",
    "kokoro"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "voices": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Voices",
      "description": "The voice for each language. auto picks the best one installed. To choose: main=kokoro:af_heart, mac:Samantha; ja=kokoro:jf_alpha; he=win:Microsoft Hila. main reads Latin-script text; ja, zh, ko, he, ar, ru, hi, el and th read their own scripts. The first voice in a list is used; the voice button steps through the main list. /read-along voices lists what's installed.",
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Speed",
      "description": "Playback speed, 0.5 to 4. Speech is made at normal speed and sped up without changing pitch.",
      "default": 1.25
    },
    "volume": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Volume",
      "description": "Speech volume in percent, 0 to 200.",
      "default": 100
    },
    "autoReadReplies": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Auto-read Claude's replies",
      "description": "off; final reads each turn's last reply; all also reads the short updates Claude writes between tool calls.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "final",
        "all"
      ]
    },
    "autoReadMine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Auto-read my messages",
      "description": "Read each message you send.",
      "default": false
    },
    "readThinking": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Read thinking updates",
      "description": "With auto-read 'all', also read Claude's thinking where your Claude Code shows it as updates. Off by default: Claude Code doesn't tell read-along whether thinking is on screen.",
      "default": false
    },
    "rewriteForSpeech": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Say numbers and symbols as words",
      "description": "Before a message is read, Claude Haiku (through your Claude Code session) lists how to say its numbers, versions, symbols and abbreviations, and the voice says those. The text on screen doesn't change. Off by default: it sends each message read to Claude once, and uses a little of your Claude usage.",
      "default": false
    },
    "readCode": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Read code blocks",
      "description": "Off says \"code block\" in place of each fenced block.",
      "default": false
    },
    "highlight": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Highlight",
      "description": "How the sentence being read is marked. reverse swaps the text and background colours, which reads on any theme. Or a background colour, optionally with a text colour after a slash: yellow, #f1fa8c/#282a36.",
      "default": "reverse"
    },
    "buttons": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Message buttons",
      "description": "hover shows a message's buttons at its top-right while the pointer is on it (they can flash as messages scroll under a resting pointer); glyph shows them only while the pointer is on the ♪ at its right; always shows them under every message; off hides them (use the player and /read-along).",
      "default": "hover",
      "options": [
        "hover",
        "glyph",
        "always",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "player": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Player",
      "description": "band: a one-row player above the prompt, always there so nothing jumps; hint: progress as dim text on the hint line under the prompt; message: progress and controls under the message being read; band+message: both.",
      "default": "band",
      "options": [
        "band",
        "hint",
        "message",
        "band+message"
      ]
    },
    "icons": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Icons",
      "description": "text: plain symbols every terminal has; nerd: Nerd Font media icons, for terminals with a Nerd Font.",
      "default": "text",
      "options": [
        "text",
        "nerd"
      ]
    },
    "duckOthers": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Lower other apps while reading",
      "description": "Windows (through WSL) only for now: turns other apps (music, a browser) down to this share of their own volume while a read plays, and back up when it stops.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "50%",
        "30%",
        "15%"
      ]
    }
  }
}
